messages:
Anya Park: Heads-up — vendor said full pen-test report lands next Tue morning. We need to lock a retest window and define remediation gating. Quick sync?
Kevin Liu: Thanks. Two quick Qs: (1) scope confirm — prod + staging? (2) will assessors need KMS read access for evidence decryption or just signed artifacts?
Samir Patel: Scope is prod read-only + staging full. For KMS: prefer they never get direct key access. We should provide encrypted blobs and signed attestations instead of giving decrypt perms.
Maria Gomez: +1 to no direct keys. Plan: create ephemeral role for assessor with strictly scoped S3 read + presigned objects; provide a signed manifest and audit logs export.
Ethan Cole: For tracking, propose: create PT epic in Security JIRA, label pt:incoming, and per-findings tickets with severity and owner. SLA: triage to owner within 24h, patch ETA within 7d (critical 48h).
Anya Park: Good. Also need acceptance criteria for retest: repro steps, PoC, fix verification steps, and log evidence (audit stream + KMS envelope metadata).
Samir Patel: Add: retention window for logs covering test window + 7 days. We must snapshot the audit stream and store checksum.
Oncall: For the retest window, suggest a 2-hour slot in off-peak (Sat 06:00–08:00 PT). We can freeze rolling deploys +/- 1h. Thoughts?
Kevin Liu: That slot works. Ops: can we schedule a short rollback corridor? If a test triggers an issue we want immediate rollback plan.
Maria Gomez: Ops/Infra will prepare a rollback runbook and a canary plan. Will also enable elevated tracing for the window and collect per-request IDs.
SecOps Bot: vuln-intake created: PT-2026-321. Evidence bucket: s3://redwood-pt-intake/PT-2026-321/ (read-only presigned links shared).
Anya Park: Great. Two remaining technical asks: (A) how do we provide KMS envelope metadata to prove key used without sharing key material? (B) how to show RBAC changes in audit logs referenceable by assessor?
Samir Patel: A) Provide the KMS key ARN, ciphertext blob, and a signed metadata file that includes envelope key ID + key wrapping algorithm + signature from our HSM. That proves we used customer-managed or platform KMS without giving access. B) For RBAC, export IAM change diffs during the intake window and attach to artifacts. Include the policy versions and request IDs.
Kevin Liu: Example artifact structure we discussed:
```
manifest.json (signed)
- artifacts/
  - proof_audit_export.tar.gz
  - kms_envelope_metadata.json
  - presigned_evidence_links.txt
```
Make sure each file has SHA256 and a timestamp.
Ethan Cole: For vuln triage, propose severity mapping + verification steps: Critical=public exploit or data exfiltration; High=privilege escalation/unauthenticated access; Medium/Low accordingly. Owners add verification checklist to the ticket.
Maria Gomez: Ops will also provide ephemeral readroom creds if vendor needs a shell or read-only console. Those creds live in the evidence bucket with short TTL and we rotate them immediately after the window.
Oncall: Who will be the single-point contact during the retest? Need 1x eng oncall + 1x security eng + 1x infra SME.
Anya Park: I'll be sec lead. Maria take infra SME? Kevin you do eng oncall shift?
Kevin Liu: I can take eng oncall that slot.
Maria Gomez: I'll take infra SME. I'll produce the runbook and the deployment freeze checklist by Fri EOD.
Samir Patel: I'll own the KMS envelope metadata creation and signing. Will post the sample signed metadata by EOD tomorrow.
Anya Park: Action items recap:
- Maria: runbook + rollback corridor + ephemeral creds (due Fri EOD)
- Samir: signed KMS metadata + manifest sample (due tomorrow)
- Ethan: create PT epic + tickets + severity mapping in Jira (today)
- Kevin: eng oncall during retest (confirmed)
- Oncall: schedule retest slot with deploy freeze (Ops to confirm calendar invite)
We will reconvene Mon to validate artifacts.
Ethan Cole: I'll create the epic now and tag owners.
SecOps Bot: Reminder: please attach all artifacts to PT-2026-321 in JIRA. Automated vulnerability scanner results will be appended to the ticket when available.
Anya Park: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks KMS signing workflow ping me directly. :thumbsup:
